feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 11:26am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 19 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs crossing the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but force 3 or 4 in the far east of the area, becoming west or southwest 5 or 6 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mostly moderate, but occasionally rough in southern and central parts of the area this evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming scattered for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers. Outbreaks of rain overnight into Thursday, risk of mist and fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in precipitation. Poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches later.
